name: NACA RM A53D02 fin-stabilized free-flight model (Ames ballistic range, M0.6-10)
_notes: Gun-launched free-flight ballistic wind-tunnel model, drag data to Mach 10. Geometry transcribed from Chuck Rogers' own RASAero fixture (RMA53D02 - 2.CDX1, posted publicly on TRF 2026-08) and cross-checked against the model drawing reproduced in Rogers & Cooper 2011 Fig 2 inset ('Dimensions are in inches'): nose 1.00 in tangent ogive (4-1/16 in ogive radius = exact tangent ogive for d/2 = 0.125 in), body 0.250 in dia x 2.50 in overall, 4 fins root 0.75 / tip 0.375 / sweep 0.375 / exposed semispan 0.125 in, tip-to-tip 0.500 in.

Fin section: HEXAGONAL BLUNT BASE (the harness's only non-airfoil/blunt-TE fin cell) with 3/16 in LE chamfer (file FX1 0.189 in -> airfoilLeDiamond; the kernel's hexbluntbase uses the LE chamfer + full-height base term, TE chamfer not applicable). Fin thickness tapers spanwise 0.030 in (root) -> 0.015 in (tip) per the Fig 2 inset; 0.0225 in here is the mean - the same single-thickness convention Rogers used in the CDX1.
The inset also shows a 0.016 in blunt LE edge; the CDX1 carries LERadius 0 and so does this fixture (a known small fidelity gap).
All values produced by the app's real importCdx1 pipeline (services/rasaeroFile.ts) on the CDX1, rounded to exact inch->SI conversions; walls are nominal (mass does not affect CD scoring).

Finish: finishpolished (0.5 um) = the importer's mapping of RASAero 'Smooth (Zero Roughness)'. Measured on the ARCAS cell: finishpolished vs polished changes tunnel-Re CD by 0.0000 at every gate Mach (not roughness-limited).
Anchor CD includes base drag at flight Re (free-flight data, model flies with a blunt base).
